hero_eyebrow: Professional Painters & Decorators — Nottingham & Surrounding Areas

services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Nottingham
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecoration and exterior paintwork to specialist finishes and property refreshes.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Complete room redecoration including wallpaper hanging, paint selection advice, and detailed finishing work. We protect your furniture and leave spaces clean and ready to use.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paintwork for walls, fascias, soffits, and doors. We prepare surfaces properly and use trade-grade paints that last longer in the Nottinghamshire climate.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create visual impact with bold colour choices, geometric designs, or textured finishes. Our team advises on colours that work with your lighting and décor.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation on feature walls or entire rooms. We handle tricky corners, pattern matching, and removal of old paper without damage to plaster.

services.title: Property Refreshes
services.desc: Fast turnaround interior updates for rental properties, house sales, or rental refreshes. We work efficiently to minimise disruption to your tenants or sale timeline.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Faux finishes, murals, stencil work, and bespoke paint effects. We create unique interior statements tailored to your vision and existing décor.

about_pullquote: We paint homes the way we'd paint our own — careful, honest, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: Walls & More was founded in 2012 by local decorator Mark Thompson, who grew frustrated with cowboys charging premium prices for shoddy work. Over twelve years, we've built a reputation across Nottingham and Aslockton for showing up on time, doing thorough prep work, and delivering finishes that last. We're a small, hands-on team that genuinely cares about the detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what they want, explain our approach clearly, and stick to agreed timescales. We don't oversell; we advise on what's needed and what's worth spending extra on. From listed properties in the city centre to modern new-builds in the suburbs, we've tackled every interior and exterior challenge Nottinghamshire throws at us.
reviews_heading: What Nottinghamshire Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Mark and the team came to paint our hallway and lounge. They arrived bang on time, took great care of the floors and furniture, and the finish is absolutely perfect. No mess left behind either. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Rachel K.

reviews.text: Had our entire house exterior painted last autumn. They did a brilliant job on the woodwork and the prep was meticulous. The paint has held up beautifully through the winter. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Helped us choose colours for our feature wall and the result is stunning. Mark explained exactly what he was doing and why. Quick, professional, and genuinely friendly. Will definitely call them again for the upstairs rooms.
reviews.author: Sophie T.
